A '''Mortar round''' was a type of explosive with a range of twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] that destroyed everything in its blast radius. [[Darth Scabrous]]' [[Darth Scabrous' HK droid|HK droid]] was equipped with mortar rounds.<ref name="Red Harvest" />
